info.name: IPPIS RBAC tests
info.description: Send the requests in order, by hand. Fill in adminUsername, adminPassword and testPassword first. The two verify-OTP requests need the code in `otp` / `testOtp`; with `pnpm dev` it is printed in the backend terminal. The requests create and then delete one test user and one custom role, and leave audit rows behind.

request.description: Set the collection variable `otp` first. With `pnpm dev` the code is printed in the backend terminal.

item.name: 03 Own profile lists roles, modules and permissions (USR-08, DSH-01)
04 No token is rejected (deny by default)

exec: pm.test("all role templates exist", () => pm.expect(roles.map(r => r.key)).to.include.members(keys));

item.name: 2. A new account has no access
23 MDA scope needs a real company (ORG-01)
25 Expiry must be in the future (ORG-06)
26 Assign Central Access Administrator to test user (USR-04)
27 Access appears without a new login (DSH-09)

exec: pm.test("does not have permissions outside the role", () => pm.expect(keys).to.not.include.members(["access.privileged.grant","access.roles.manage","payroll.cycles.approve"]));

item.name: 28 Superadmin can see the user's roles

exec: pm.test("assignment is recorded with its scope", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().data[0].scope_level).to.eql("global"));

item.name: 36 Cannot reset a privileged account's password
S1 Backups: no token is rejected
S2 Settings list: no token is rejected
S3 Debug route: no token is rejected
S4 Backups: delegated admin is refused
S5 Create backup: delegated admin is refused
S6 Restore backup: delegated admin is refused
S7 Download backup: delegated admin is refused
S8 Email settings: delegated admin is refused
S9 Change settings: delegated admin is refused
S10 Debug route: delegated admin is refused
S11 Backups: Super Administrator is allowed
S12 Email settings: Super Administrator is allowed
E1 Employees: no token is rejected
E2 Dashboard figures: no token is rejected
E3 Employees: user without an HR role is refused
E11 Dashboard figures: any signed-in admin is allowed
E12 Give the user the Central HR Administrator role
E16 HR role still cannot touch backups
E17 Take the HR role away again
E18 Employees: refused again straight away

P1 Payroll: no token is rejected
P2 Finance: no token is rejected
P3 Payroll: user without a payroll role is refused
P8 Give the user the Central Payroll Administrator role

P11 Payroll role does not open finance

P15 Finance: Super Administrator is allowed

H1 Core HR: no token is rejected
H2 Attendance: no token is rejected
H3 Awards: user without an HR role is refused
H10 Announcements: allowed, the role includes viewing the organisation
H11 Create a company (MDA): view-only user is refused
H12 Delete a department: view-only user is refused
H13 Give the user the Central HR Administrator role
H17 HR role does not open payroll
H18 Take the HR role away again
H19 Awards: refused again straight away
M1 Assets: no token is rejected
M2 Recruitment: no token is rejected
M3 Assets: user without the role is refused
M11 Assets: Super Administrator is allowed
M12 Recruitment: Super Administrator is allowed
M13 Training: Super Administrator is allowed
39 Granting payroll.cycles.approve as well is refused
41 Cannot grant a permission to yourself
45 Add a permission to the custom role
46 Conflicting permission in the same role is refused
48 Cannot edit a role you hold
52 A retired role cannot be assigned
59 Suspended user cannot request an OTP
61 Old token stays revoked after reactivation
62 Changes are in the audit log
63 Deleting a user needs a reason
L1 A code cannot be requested without the password step

exec: pm.test("asks for the password first", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include("password first"));

item.name: L2 Unknown user gets the same answer as a wrong password

request.description: Send this five times. Each one should be 401 with the same message as L3.

exec: pm.test("does not reveal whether the user exists", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Invalid username or password"));

item.name: L3 Wrong password for a real account

request.description: Send once only. Five wrong passwords lock this username from your address for 15 minutes.

exec: pm.test("same message as an unknown user", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Invalid username or password"));

item.name: L4 Sixth wrong password is blocked

request.description: Send after L2 has been sent five times.

item.name: L5 Start a sign-in with the password
L6 A wrong code is refused and counted

request.description: Send four times. attemptsLeft should count down 4, 3, 2, 1.

item.name: L7 The fifth wrong code throws the code away

request.description: Send after L6 has been sent four times.

exec: pm.test("asks for the password again", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include("password again"));

item.name: L8 The discarded code can no longer be tried

exec: pm.test("no code is waiting", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include("No OTP found"));

item.name: L9 A new code needs the password again
